name: One-pass Spectral Rendering Integral
definition: Bergner et al. [7, 8] developed a spectral volume rendering integral based on a simplified multiple scattering model. It removes global illumination elements to facilitate ray casting with local illumination and post-illumination with different light sources.
summary: The One-pass Spectral Rendering Integral is a real-time approximation for light transport in participating media that simplifies multiple scattering by removing global illumination and using a local Phong model.
